intro: One small packet of kacang putih gives about 200 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from nuts and beans fried in oil, especially peanuts.
diet: Yes, kacang putih is an okay snack when you're trying to lose weight. It has some protein and fibre, so it's more filling than chips. But it's easy to finish a big packet without noticing. The key is to buy a small packet and eat slowly.
tips: Choose roasted chickpeas or peas, and cut down on fried peanuts.
Buy small packets only. Don't bring a big packet in front of the TV.
Have it with plain water or teh O kosong, not sweet drinks.

swap.name: Boiled chickpeas (kacang kuda), 1/2 cup
swap.why: No frying oil, high in fibre, and still feels like a snack with a bit of salt and pepper.

faq.q: What exactly is in kacang putih?
faq.a: It's a mix of beans and grains like chickpeas, peanuts, mung beans, green peas and sometimes small muruku. Most are fried or roasted with spices.

faq.q: Is kacang putih okay for people with diabetes?
faq.a: It has fibre and protein that help, but it still has carbs and salt. Watch the packet size and check with your doctor or dietitian for advice that suits you.

faq.q: Why is Ipoh kacang putih famous?
faq.a: Ipoh, especially Buntong, has long been known as a centre for making kacang putih. Many people buy it as buah tangan because there's lots of choice and it's crunchy.
